g.title: VTES_V5_FULL_GAMELOOP_FSM
g.text: VTES v5 — Full Game Loop FSM (5 players) — rules-level, card-agnostic

g.title: cluster_META
g.text: META LOOP: Game continues until one Methuselah remains (VP scoring)

g.title: cluster_CONTEST
g.text: ADVANCED: Contest (unique cards & titles) — paid each unlock phase

g.title: cluster_MINION
g.text: Minion Phase Core Loop (actions resolve one-by-one)

g.title: cluster_BLEED
g.text: Bleed Subloop (directed at prey by default; Edge handling)

g.title: cluster_BLOCK
g.text: Block Attempt + Block Resolution FSM (stealth/intercept + impulse + post-block exceptions)

g.title: cluster_COMBAT
g.text: Combat FSM (7-step rounds per v5 rulebook; card-agnostic)

g.title: cluster_CARDPLAY
g.text: Card Play Micro-FSM (rule-level, applies to any card/effect)

g.title: cluster_IMPULSE
g.text: Shared Impulse Window (play/pass loop; timers are ENV-defined) — EXPLICIT ORDER

g.title: cluster_DATASET
g.text: ENGINE BUILD-TIME: Card Dataset Integration (vtes_v5.json) — non-gameplay loop

g.title: cluster_HOOKS
g.text: RUNTIME: Card Timing Hooks (generalized, used to open impulse windows)

g.title: META_SETUP
g.text: • Shuffle both decks, cut by predator
• Deal 4 crypt cards to uncontrolled region face down

g.title: HAND_RULE
g.text: Whenever hand size changes or cards are added/removed:
Immediately draw up to, or discard down to, hand size

g.title: DRAW_REPLACE
g.text: Whenever you play a card from hand,
draw 1 from library to replace it
If library empty: you continue playing, but don't draw.

g.title: META_TURN_CLOCK
g.text: Turn passes clockwise to next Methuselah

g.title: META_SCORING
g.text: • Gain 1 VP when prey is ousted

g.title: POOL_ZERO
g.text: Remove all cards they control from game
Return rivals' owned cards they controlled at end

g.title: PH_UNLOCK
g.text: • (Adv) Optional: burn 1 pool per Infernal minion to unlock
• If you have the Edge, you may gain 1 pool from blood bank

g.title: PH_MASTER
g.text: • Choose ordering vs other master-phase effects

g.title: CONTEST_CHECK
g.text: If unique card/title duplicates enter play -> contest begins
All contested copies turn face down (out of play)

g.title: PH_MINION
g.text: • Ready, unlocked minions may take actions
• Each action fully resolves before next

g.title: PH_INFLUENCE
g.text: seat1 gets 1, seat2 gets 2, seat3 gets 3 transfers on their first influence phase
(seats 4-5 reach their first influence phase after this)
• Spend transfers to influence/reveal vampires etc.

g.title: PH_DISCARD
g.text: • (Adv) Use DPA to play event (≤1 per phase; each event only once per game)

g.title: CONTEST_PAY
g.text: • Pay cost to contest (card: 1 pool; title: 1 blood)
• Vampires in torpor must yield contested titles

g.title: CONTEST_RESOLVE
g.text: • Your copy unlocks & turns face up during your next unlock

g.title: INF_SPEND
g.text: • 1 transfer: move 1 pool -> uncontrolled vampire (adds blood)
• 2 transfers: move 1 blood from uncontrolled vampire -> your pool
• 4 transfers + burn 1 pool: move vampire from crypt -> uncontrolled

g.title: INF_REVEAL
g.text: At any time in this phase:
• move to ready region face up, unlocked
• excess blood returns to blood bank

g.title: DIS_USE
g.text: B) (Adv) Play 1 event card (≤1 per phase)

g.title: MINION_MANDATORY
g.text: • If any of your ready, unlocked vampires have 0 blood,
• While mandatory actions remain, you cannot take non-mandatory actions.
• If multiple mandatory actions exist, choose order.
(Other mandatory actions can exist via card text.)

g.title: ACTION_DECLARE
g.text: • Basic bleed / basic hunt / action card in hand / effect in play

g.title: ACTION_BLOCK_WHO
g.text: • Directed at a Methuselah (e.g., bleed prey): that Methuselah may attempt to block
• Directed at a minion: that minion's controller may attempt to block
• Undirected: prey and predator may attempt to block
(Other cases require card-specific rules; excluded here)

g.title: ACTION_BLOCK_LOOP
g.text: Each eligible player may attempt with a ready, unlocked minion

g.title: ACTION_BLOCKED_PATH
g.text: Action is unsuccessful; resolve blocked-action consequences, then end the action

g.title: ACTION_END
g.text: If a minion unlocks during this phase (effect), it may act again

g.title: BLEED_START
g.text: If action is BLEED and is unblocked:
• action modifiers & reactions may modify/redirect/reduce (card-agnostic here)

g.title: HUNT_START
g.text: If action is HUNT and is unblocked:

g.title: ACTION_SUCCESS->REF_START
g.text: if action calls referendum / blood hunt

g.title: BLEED_DONE
g.text: Bleed subloop ends -> return to action end

g.title: HUNT_GAIN
g.text: Acting vampire gains hunt amount blood

g.title: HUNT_DONE
g.text: Hunt subloop ends -> return to action end

g.title: IMPULSE_WINDOW
g.text: A play window exists at specific FSM steps.
ENV sets a timer per polled player; timeout => auto-PASS.

g.title: BLOCK_WINDOW
g.text: • Same minion cannot play same reaction/modifier more than once per action
• Impulse cycles; any effect returns impulse to acting

g.title: BLOCK_RESOLUTION
g.text: • Any card played to perform the action is burned
B) blocking minion enters combat with acting minion
If an effect ends the action before block resolution

g.title: BLOCK_ENDED_EARLY_Q
g.text: Did an effect end the action

g.title: BLOCKED_TORPOR_SPECIAL
g.text: Special rule: Leave Torpor is blocked
No combat (minions in torpor cannot enter combat).
If blocker is a vampire: optional immediate diablerie opportunity.
If blocker is an ally or declines: action simply fails.

g.title: IMP_ACTING
g.text: Acting Methuselah ALWAYS has impulse first.
('Acting' = player who is currently resolving an action/card/effect)

g.title: COMBAT_CARD_LIMIT
g.text: • The only minion cards that can be played during combat are combat cards.
ADV: Some combat cards are played by minions "not involved in the current combat"; minions controlled by ANY Methuselah can play those cards.
(Non-combatants can play ONLY if the combat card text explicitly allows it.)

g.title: COMBAT_OOC_NOTE
g.text: A minion not involved in the current combat may play a combat card ONLY if that combat card explicitly says so.
Sequencing is still by impulse during combat:
Acting Methuselah first; once they pass, defending Methuselah; then remaining Methuselahs clockwise (5-player).
If any Methuselah plays an effect, impulse snaps back to the acting Methuselah.

g.title: COMBAT_S1_BEFORE_RANGE
g.text: Play cards/effects usable before range is chosen.
NOTE: 'before range is determined' effects must be played
before the acting minion decides whether to play a maneuver.

g.title: COMBAT_PRIORITY_NOTE
g.text: At every combat stage, the acting minion gets first opportunity
Operationally this is handled by impulse:
• Acting Methuselah keeps impulse until they pass.
• Then the defending Methuselah gets impulse.
• Then the remaining Methuselahs get impulse clockwise (5-player).
Other Methuselahs can only act if a card/effect explicitly allows it
(e.g., combat cards playable by minions not involved in the current combat).

g.title: COMBAT_S2_DETERMINE_RANGE
g.text: Use maneuvers to change/offset to close or long.
No minion may play two maneuvers in a row.

g.title: COMBAT_END_IMMEDIATE
g.text: (if a combatant is no longer ready)
Return to action flow after resolving required steps.

g.title: COMBAT_RANGE_SET
g.text: Range is set for this round
that also sets the initial strike choice constraint.)

g.title: COMBAT_S3_BEFORE_STRIKES
g.text: Play cards/effects usable after range is set

g.title: COMBAT_S4_STRIKE
g.text: Resolve 1+ strike pairs at the same range.

g.title: STRIKE_TARGET_NOTE
g.text: At long range, a ranged strike may target an opposing retainer
(instead of the opposing minion) if announced when strike is announced.

g.title: STRIKE_CHOOSE_ACTING
g.text: From: hand strike / weapon / combat card / other strike source.
If maneuver was used from a strike card/weapon this round:
no other strike for the initial strike.

g.title: STRIKE_RESOLVE
g.text: If a combatant becomes not ready at any point:

g.title: COMBAT_S5_DAMAGE_RES
g.text: A) Prevent damage (play prevention combat cards)
- Vampires burn 1 blood per unprevented damage
- Allies/retainers burn 1 life per unprevented damage

g.title: STRIKE_GAIN_ADDITIONAL
g.text: Announced/performed only after the first pair.
Acting decides to gain additional strikes before opposing.
Only 1 card/effect to gain additional strikes per round ('limited').
(only minions with remaining additional strikes act).
All additional strikes occur at the same range.

g.title: COMBAT_S6_PRESS
g.text: Use presses to continue into another round or to end combat.
Combatants may continue playing presses to offset opponent's last press.
No minion may play two presses in a row.

g.title: COMBAT_S7_END_ROUND_PREMATURE
g.text: Note: Occurs even if combat ends prematurely.

g.title: COMBAT_S7_END_ROUND
g.text: Note: This step also occurs even if combat ends prematurely.

g.title: REF_POLL_OPEN
g.text: Impulse cycles; votes/ballots cast in order
• Acting may delay casting until they choose to cast
• Edge holder may burn Edge to gain 1 vote

g.title: REF_RESOLVE
g.text: Note: political action still 'successful' if unblocked even if referendum fails

g.title: REF_END
g.text: Referendum ends -> return to action resolution flow

g.title: DIABLERIE_ACTION
g.text: Diablerie steps are a single unit:

g.title: PREY_OUST
g.text: If you are not ousted at same time, gain 6 pool

g.title: CP_DECLARE
g.text: • card may be temporarily out-of-play until resolution

g.title: CP_ASPLAYED
g.text: Use ABC sequencing until all pass

g.title: CP_RESOLVE
g.text: • if canceled, card effect does not happen
• move card to ash heap or into play upon resolution
• acting regains impulse after any effect resolves

g.title: CP_REPLACE
g.text: • after 'as played' window closes and card is resolved/canceled

g.title: IMP_POLL
g.text: (If PLAY happens: resolve it, then acting gets impulse back)

g.title: IMP_PLAY
g.text: 1) run Card Play Micro-FSM (declare -> as played -> resolve -> replace)

g.title: IMP_PASS
g.text: advance impulse to the next Methuselah
according to the context-specific order below.

g.title: IMP_ORDER_SINGLE
g.text: Context A: Combat OR action directed at a single Methuselah
2) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order
(5-player example: A -> D -> next clockwise after D -> ... -> last)

g.title: IMP_ORDER_SET
g.text: Context B: Action directed at a SET of Methuselahs
1) Those targeted Methuselahs in clockwise order
2) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order

g.title: IMP_ORDER_UNDIR
g.text: 3) Then every other Methuselah in clockwise order
(5-player example: A -> Prey -> Predator -> Cross1 -> Cross2)

g.title: IMP_NEXT
g.text: Give impulse to next Methuselah in the chosen order
(if that Methuselah plays, impulse snaps back to acting)

g.title: IMP_COMBAT_DEF_NOTE
g.text: In combat, "defending Methuselah" = the controller of the opposing combatant.
Other Methuselahs only get impulse if the current window allows them to play something (e.g., a combat card explicitly playable by a minion not involved).

g.title: IMP_CLOSE
g.text: Return to parent FSM step (advance state)
